summary: Tested multi-bank + UPI QR feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing (list/create rules, activate + isolation + 404, deposit stamping w/ account_id, per-account totals via aggregation, wallet/deposit-info shape, suspension 403 for add & activate). Frontend: admin console Bank Account panel renders 2 cards with active badge, per-account week+all-time totals, QR for account with UPI, toggle to activate an inactive account works, Add Account modal opens with live UPI preview QR. Player Add-Coins modal shows active bank details side-by-side with UPI QR (deposit-upi-qr present), UPI ID row visible, submit works and appears in history.

minor.issue: Legacy accounts created before upi_id field is missing the 'upi_id' key entirely (rather than null). New accounts include upi_id=null. Consider normalizing the response so 'upi_id' is always present (defaulting to null) for frontend safety.

action_items: (Minor) In list_bank_accounts response, ensure every account exposes upi_id (default null) so frontends never see undefined for legacy docs.
critical_code_review_comments: deposit_service.get_active_bank_account query does not filter by callback role but works because admin_id is scoped to the caller.id in the router — OK.

activate_bank_account uses update_many + update_one sequentially (not atomic); acceptable for single-user scope but worth noting: a race between two concurrent activates from the same admin could briefly leave zero active accounts. Consider a transaction or single aggregation pipeline update.

_week_start_iso uses ISO string comparison for confirmed_at >= week_start; correct only because created/confirmed_at are always stored as timezone-aware ISO with '+00:00'. If any code path writes a naive/non-UTC ISO, week totals would silently drift.
In create_bank_account, no de-duplication on (account_number, ifsc) — same account can be added twice. Consider a soft-warn / unique compound index if that's intended.
BankAccountPanel triggers `activate` only via Switch onCheckedChange; because the active switch is disabled, users cannot toggle OFF the active one (correct — exactly one active enforced).

Two TEST_MB_* deposit requests were confirmed as part of stamping test (₹111 to A, ₹222 to B) — reflected in admin1's HDFC TEST all-time total (₹888).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-bank + UPI/QR feature verified. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_multi_bank_upi.py (uses -o addopts= to bypass xdist since fixtures share state via module scope). Note MONGO_URL/DB_NAME in .env are quoted — always strip quotes before using in scripts. Manager admin cap is 3 by default; raise via PATCH /admin/managers/{id}/max-admins with null before creating new test admins. There's no HTTP endpoint to suspend a user — direct db.users update is required.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking. The only observation is legacy accounts missing upi_id key in list response.
